name: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer Société Anonyme
summary: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer Société Anonyme, known as Cafom, specializes in supplying a diverse range of home furnishing products across Europe and Asia. The company distributes various goods and services through multiple brands: DARTY for household appliances, BUT for general home equipment, Habitat for design and manufacturing, Nature & Discoveries for natural and wellness items, BUT Cosy for furniture, decor, and appliances, and Music & Sound for musical instruments. These operations are particularly active in French overseas territories, including Guadeloupe, French Guiana, Martinique, Saint-Martin, Reunion Island, and New Caledonia. Cafom also manages the online retail platforms Vente-Unique.com and DirectLowCost.com. The company was founded in Paris, France, in 1985.
